wikitext:
This page is a list of all available '''[[ingredients]]''' in {{TWMS}}. They were needed to craft [[The Witcher Monster Slayer bombs|bombs]], [[The Witcher Monster Slayer oils|oils]], [[The Witcher Monster Slayer potions|potions]] and [[The Witcher Monster Slayer baits|baits]]. Monster remains and [[powdered monster tissue]] were obtained by slaying [[The Witcher Monster Slayer bestiary|monsters]], while herbs and roots were gathered from shrubs. Version 1.2 added 3 store-bought ingredients: [[bear fat]], [[White Gull]] and linen cloth.
